interface.longDescription:
FantasyBot Sports is your AI fantasy sports assistant for fantasy football, basketball, baseball, and hockey. Connect your Sleeper, ESPN, Yahoo, or other supported league and get advice built on your actual roster, or ask about any player with no league needed.

Once your league is linked in the FantasyBot app, answers use your real team: start/sit verdicts for every slot in your lineup, waiver pickups actually available in your league with safe drop candidates, your team's grade with positional strengths and weaknesses, your weekly matchup outlook, opponent roster lookups, and where you rank in your league's power rankings.

Ask in plain English:

- "How's my fantasy football team looking?" (roster grades, matchup previews, league power rankings)
- "Who should I pick up off waivers?" (waiver targets with suggested drops)
- "Should I start Jefferson or Chase this week?" (start/sit advice with projections and matchups)
- "Is this trade fair?" (trade analysis with player values and rest-of-season outlook)
- "Top 30 WRs this week" (position rankings for any sport)
- "Compare Jokic and Wembanyama" (head-to-head player comparisons)
- "How is Shohei Ohtani playing?" (player stats with trends and matchups)

No league setup needed to start: player stats with trends and matchup grades, trade analysis with market values for both sides, start/sit calls for any players, trending adds and drops across Sleeper leagues, player trade values, position rankings, and head-to-head comparisons.

Every answer is backed by real player stats, projections, injury status, and trend data, shown in interactive cards right in the chat.

Supports: Fantasy Football (NFL), Fantasy Basketball (NBA), Fantasy Baseball (MLB), Fantasy Hockey (NHL).
defaultPrompt: Who should I pick up off waivers in my fantasy football league?
Start Smith-Njigba, Christian Watson, or McConkey?
Should I trade Christian Watson and Saquon Barkley for Jahmyr Gibbs?

positive.prompt: Should I start Ja'Marr Chase or Justin Jefferson this week in PPR?
positive.expected_behavior: A start/sit card ranking both players with weekly projections, recent trends, and matchups, plus a one-line recommendation.

positive.prompt: Is it a fair fantasy trade if I give Bijan Robinson and get CeeDee Lamb?
positive.expected_behavior: A trade card with both sides' player values, PPG, trends, and rest-of-season outlook, and a verdict on which side wins.

positive.prompt: Who are the top 20 fantasy wide receivers this week?
positive.expected_behavior: A ranked list of the top 20 fantasy WRs with their points or projections, shown in a rankings card.

positive.description: Lineup for the user's own connected league (reviewer account has a league connected in the FantasyBot app)
positive.prompt: Who should I start this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the reviewer account's connected league and returns a START/FLEX/SIT verdict for every rostered player, with projections and opponents.

positive.description: Waiver pickups in the user's own connected league (reviewer account has a league connected in the FantasyBot app)
positive.prompt: Who should I pick up off waivers in my league?
positive.expected_behavior: Pickups actually available in the reviewer account's league, fitted to its roster's needs, plus drop candidates and the best available player at each position.

negative.description: Betting odds. FantasyBot does not provide betting odds or picks. Expected fallback: say FantasyBot covers fantasy sports, not betting, and offer fantasy help such as start/sit.
negative.prompt: What are the best sportsbook bets for Sunday's NFL games?

negative.description: Making a roster move. FantasyBot reads leagues but cannot make moves. Expected fallback: explain the user makes the add/drop in their league's app; it may offer to check whether the Ravens defense is a good pickup.
negative.prompt: Drop my kicker and pick up the Ravens defense in my league for me.

negative.description: DFS lineup. FantasyBot does not build daily fantasy (DFS) lineups. Expected fallback: say DFS isn't supported and offer season-long help such as start/sit or player comparisons.
negative.prompt: Build me a DraftKings lineup for tonight under the salary cap.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds a skill that guides ChatGPT to the right FantasyBot tool for each fantasy question, led by the user's connected league; declares the MCP server in the package; updates the tagline to AI Start/Sit, Waivers & Trades; fills in capability labels, keywords, brand colors, and the icon files the plugin package format requires; makes the listing available in all countries; leads the description with league connection; refreshes the starter prompts with matching screenshots (league waivers, start/sit, trade); and corrects the description: trending adds and drops come from Sleeper leagues.
